finding: Another agent's staged files (source and task-plan) make `taskflow close` fail `ATM_TASKFLOW_CLOSE_INDEX_NOT_ISOLATED`; unattributable staged source cannot be deferred by `--defer-foreign-staged`, so the operator must manually park/restore the foreign staged set.
expectedBehavior: The close window should snapshot-park unattributable foreign staged entries with an explicit restore contract (or wait on a shared index lease) instead of failing isolation.
evidenceOrRepro: TASK-AAO-FABLE-002 close required manually unstaging codex-backlog-captain's stalled staged files and restaging them after the closure commit.
followUp: Closed on 2026-09-02. ATM-GOV-0233 introduced the immutable `atm.taskflowCloseIndexIsolationReceipt.v1` park/restore contract, so unattributable foreign staged entries are represented explicitly instead of silently dropped or manually improvised. Current verification passed: tests/cli/taskflow-close-index-isolation.test.ts and tests/cli/taskflow-close-defer-governance-dirty.test.ts. The latter fixture was updated to provide the required done/released ledger for its foreign git-head receipt; active, malformed, or unowned foreign provenance remains fail-closed. Future regressions require a new incident item.
